title: Sell only certified gas appliances
what: Sell gas appliances only if they are certified (by the holder of a certification authority) and labelled as the regulations require.

sources.title: Gas and Electricity (Consumer Safety) Act 2017 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not sell a gas appliance or type of gas appliance unless it is— (a) a certified gas appliance, and (b) labelled in accordance with the regulations
